answer: We define a mechanism using dynamic opportunity-cost bonds and a subgame-perfect slashing matrix to precipitate a canyon between honest actors and Sybil adversaries. Staking collateral and zero-knowledge verifiable delays ensure that any residual ember of profit from identity multiplication is eclipsed by extreme economic penalties. Consequently, the expected attack utility remains strictly negative, forcing convergence to a Nash equilibrium where the lagoon of distributed capital cannot offset the cost of coordinated subversion.
